selected_evidence.requirement: Healthy 3-node Galera cluster serving application data (baseline before maintenance)
selected_evidence.summary: wsrep_cluster_size=3, status Primary, node1/node2/node3 all Synced, and appdb.orders (5 rows) present identically on all three nodes.

selected_evidence.requirement: Committed write made just before full cluster shutdown, to prove durability across the maintenance window
selected_evidence.summary: Inserted a 6th row ('pre-shutdown-write') on node1; COUNT=6, SUM=2093.39 immediately before shutdown.

selected_evidence.requirement: Cluster brought down completely for the maintenance window
selected_evidence.summary: mariadb cleanly stopped on node3, node2, then node1 (grastate.dat seqno 13/14/15 confirming node1 had the highest seqno and safe_to_bootstrap=1); systemctl is-active returns inactive (exit 3) on all three nodes simultaneously, proving the whole cluster was down.

selected_evidence.requirement: Cluster brought back up after the maintenance window with every committed write present and all three members serving
selected_evidence.summary: node1 bootstrapped via galera_new_cluster (highest seqno) and shows 6 rows/sum 2093.39; node2 and node3 started and rejoined; final check shows wsrep_cluster_size=3, status Primary, all nodes Synced, and 6 rows / sum 2093.39 replicated identically on all three nodes.

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 mandatory restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id d546da19...; systemctl reboot acknowledged and returned before disconnect; subsequent poll timed out (node down) then returned new boot_id f023a81e... (changed); mariadb active and cluster shows size 3, Synced, 6 rows/2093.39 post-reboot.

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 mandatory restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 8c28f3cd...; reboot acknowledged; connection dropped/reset during reboot; new boot_id b309ebe6... (changed) confirms restart; mariadb transitioned activating->active as it rejoined via SST/IST; cluster shows size 3, Synced, 6 rows/2093.39 post-reboot.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id e65e6bcf...; reboot acknowledged; connection dropped during reboot; new boot_id b3e226f3... (changed) confirms restart; mariadb active; final cluster-wide check on all 3 nodes shows wsrep_cluster_size=3, Primary, Synced, and 6 rows/sum 2093.39 consistent everywhere, confirming full quorum and data recovery after all three restarts.
